consequence.statement: Operators must execute sequential upgrades through intermediate v1 minor versions before upgrading to v2.0; CRD migrations are performed at each minor release and skipping versions may result in incomplete migrations or upgrade failure.

assertion.statement: Crossplane v2.0 requires sequential upgrade through intermediate v1 minor versions, with mandatory upgrade to v1.20 as the final v1 step before upgrading to v2.0; direct upgrade from earlier v1 versions to v2.0 is not supported.
